chunks: If it is said: Your claim of the long life of your Patron is an extraordinary matter
as he remains, according to you, of complete intelligence, full strength and youthfulness
because he is, according to you, at this time which is the year 491 A.H., one hundred and ninety-seven years old
as his birth was, according to you, in the year 256 A.H.
ai.seo_question: What is the calculated age of Imam Mahdi (a.s) in 491 A.H. according to the Shia claim of longevity?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi addresses the rationalist objection that a lifespan of 191 years (calculated as 256–447 A.H. in the text, though the summary notes 197) contradicts natural human limits, arguing that prolonged life is a valid *kharq al-‘adah* (exception to custom) for the Imam. This passage highlights the Shia scholarly defense of the Imam's physical presence and vitality, asserting that his preserved youth and intellect serve as signs of his divine preservation rather than anomalies.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: If it is said: Your claim of the long life of your Patron [Imam Mahdi (a.s)] is extraordinary,
as according to you, he remains a man of complete intelligence, strength and youthful looks,
because he is, according to you, at this time in 447 A.H., a hundred and ninety-seven years old,
as his birth was in 256 A.H.
